title: Inter-symbiosis
statement: In Inter-Symbiosis, Hung transmutes post-consumer waste, specifically discarded plastic bags, into ethereal, biomorphic forms that meditate on the interconnectedness of self, community, and the environment. By manipulating these synthetic skins, the sculpture challenges the perceived dichotomy between the artificial and the organic. From a precise vantage point, the work’s seemingly chaotic, fluid structure collapses into the recognizable form of the yin-yang symbol, reinforcing the Taoist principle that interdependent aspects constitute a greater, balanced whole. Through this interplay, the work suggests harmony is not found in individual perfection but emerges through the act of relational connection.
statement_zh: 道家相信獨立個體經過結合，才能達到平衡，猶如太極的陰陽。藝術家認為每個個體都是獨⼀無二的，當人換位思考，理解並尊重萬物，才能在其中找到平衡，形成互惠理想的共生。
作品看似抽象無序的有機形體，與觀者產⽣自我的連結，也許如植物、魚尾、舞者等；而從特定角度觀看，為萬物一體兩面、相生互換的太極陰陽符號。
相生開放式的觀看角度，產生各式各樣的面相，都是組成這個世界的⼀部分。
